translations.web: For Yahweh says, “You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.”
translations.bsb: For this is what the LORD says: “You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.”
translations.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
translations.asv: For thus saith Jehovah, Ye were sold for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
